## Delivered

### HPHT Completions — SPE Kuala Lumpur, 2018
A short course on HPHT completion design, drawing on the Petronas Carigali HPHT carbonate programme and the Maersk Oil Culzean (UK Central North Sea) experience. Covered design philosophy, material selection, tubular stress analysis under HPHT load cases, DST design, and risk-management approaches for HPHT operations.

## In preparation — SPE Distinguished Lecturer Programme 2027–28

I am preparing an application to the **SPE Distinguished Lecturer Programme** for the 2027–28 cycle on the topic:

> **"From rig floor to optimisation model: applying mixed-integer programming and survival analysis to mature-field workover programmes."**

Outline lectures:

1.  **The economics of mature-field workover programmes** — why this is the largest production-recovery lever the operator has, and why it has historically been under-instrumented.
2.  **Workover fleet optimisation under non-productive-time uncertainty** — the MILP formulation that resolves the dedicated-heavy-duty-rig business case on a mature giant field, in operational rather than mathematical language.
3.  **Predicting ESP failures** — survival analysis applied to electric submersible pump run-life data, and the operational re-architecture that follows from a useful prediction.
4.  **Building a wells engineering organisation that uses analytics** — the cultural and organisational changes that turn good models into operational decisions, drawing on the Rumaila experience (2024–2025).

## Available for
